content.short: 9000 Unique Digital Estates Represented As NFTs On Cardano.
content.description:
Adaville Metaverse is a virtual reality platform powered by the Cardano blockchain where users can explore and experience the limits of their imagination with the experience set across a Cardano themed urban landscape.

Adaville Lands are unique digital parcels of lands represented as NFTs On Cardano. Each Adaville land parcel is unique with the owners having complete ownership of their Lands. A capped total of 9000 lands will exist within Adaville, contained in a map that forms Adaville.
